desktop.notesZh:
批次十一（通用文案 + 推荐插件导入导出 + 指令集两大卡 + 企业规范 markdown + 测试流图点击详情）
① 工作流·通用：「测试流图」开关描述去掉括注，改为「关闭后，对话 Tab 不再显示「测试流图」。」。② 设置·推荐插件：新增导入/导出——「导出清单」把当前生效的推荐清单存为 featured-plugins.json 配置文件；「导入清单」选择配置文件后整体验证（schema/revision/每条字段），通过即整体替换当前推荐列表：host 侧新 @Remote exportManifest/importManifest，导入落 dsh home 的 featured-manifest.json 覆盖层（优先于内置种子，重启后仍生效；坏覆盖层报错绝不静默回退种子）。③ 工作流·指令集：删除图例；拆成「状态指令 · 按阶段查看」与「全局指令 · 任何状态可用」两张大卡片；每条指令三行详解——作用（帮助表原文）/功能（机制）/结果（运行后客户看到什么）。④ 工作流·企业规范：删除图例；文档预览全屏模态框改用 MarkdownText 渲染 markdown（标题/列表/表格/代码块带复制工具条），纯文本文档优雅降级为段落。⑤ 会话测试流图：改为左右分栏点击检视——左侧状态色步骤链（编号+圆点+名称+工具·类型+命令+指标一眼可见），点击任一步骤右侧详情面板给出 工具/类型/命令、该步骤的作用说明、执行结果（覆盖率行% vs 阈值、静态错误数、报告时间、HTML 报告路径与一键打开）与未运行提示；数据契约与批次十一致。
desktop.notesEn:
Batch eleven (general copy + recommended-list import/export + commands two big cards + enterprise markdown + test-flow click-to-inspect)
(1) Workflow > general: the Test-flow toggle description drops the parenthetical.
(2) Settings > recommended plugins: import/export — Export list saves the effective recommended list as a featured-plugins.json config file; Import list validates a chosen file whole (schema/revision/every field) and replaces the list on acceptance: new host Remotes exportManifest/importManifest, the import lands as a featured-manifest.json overlay in the dsh home (overrides the bundled seed, survives restarts; a broken overlay reports its error instead of silently falling back).
(3) Workflow > commands: legend deleted; split into two big cards — state commands (by stage) and global commands (any state); every command answers three captioned lines: purpose (verbatim from the help tables) / what it does (mechanism) / result (what the customer sees after it runs).
(4) Workflow > enterprise standards: legend deleted; the fullscreen document-preview modal now renders markdown via MarkdownText (headings/lists/tables/code fences with a copy toolbar); plain-text documents degrade gracefully to paragraphs.
(5) Session test-flow tab: a click-to-inspect split — a state-colored step rail on the left (index + dot + names + tool/type + command + metric at a glance), and clicking any step fills the right detail pane with tool/type/command, the step's purpose copy, its result (coverage line % vs threshold, static error count, report time, the HTML report path with one-click open) or the not-run hint; the data contract is unchanged from batch ten.
